dataset_title: Field yield, chemical characterization, batch digestion, and ADM1 fit for residue grass
source_title: Green biomass to biogas – a study on anaerobic digestion of residue grass
license: No explicit open-data license identified; attributed factual observations are recorded, but no full text is redistributed.
data_basis: Phase 1 records retain field fresh-mass yield in kg/m2 and source-reported fresh- or dry-matter composition. Phase 5 records include measured 40-day batch BGP/BMP in Nm3/kg TS, source-reported theoretical COD and C/N, fitted ADM1 parameter values, and modeled comparison outputs. No unit conversions or recalibration were applied.

methods.field_sampling: Three grassland classes (uncultivated land, Sava riverbank, highway verge); nine 2 m2 quadrats per class; collected end of April 2018. Field yield reported as mean and SD.
methods.chemical_analysis: Moisture, ash, heating values and elemental composition tested using HRN EN ISO methods listed in Table 1; paired dry-matter values retained where the source table defines fresh (dry) basis.
methods.batch_digestion: 250 mL batch flasks, 39 C, 42-day operation, triplicate tests, 9 g TS per reactor, 6% DM, inoculum-to-substrate ratio 1:1; BGP/BMP reported after 40 days.
methods.adm1_fit: Selected disintegration, hydrolysis and Monod constants fitted to MRG2 riverbank-grass gas production and gas-composition data; predictions compared with MRG1 and MRG3.

source_locations: Table 3 field yield and feed composition
Table 8 modeled BGP and relative errors
uncertainty: Field-yield SD is retained where reported. Most chemistry, BMP, and fitted-parameter rows have no uncertainty estimate; empty uncertainty is not zero. Parameter covariance/confidence intervals are not reported.
applicability: Primary literature comparator for roadside/residue grass availability, composition, biochemical methane potential, and grass-specific ADM1 fitting. Not GreenHub site data, a protein-extraction residual, continuous reactor performance, or a Dutch seasonal default.
limitations: One April sampling campaign in Croatia; quadrat yield cannot be annualized or treated as accessible supply.
BMP is a laboratory batch endpoint on TS basis, not methane yield per VS, continuous yield, or a direct GreenHub residual performance factor.
Co-digestion records contain maize silage and/or cattle slurry and must not be used as grass-only values.
Fitted Table 6 parameters are specific to one riverbank sample (MRG2) and the study's modified ADM1 model; direct transfer to GreenHub is not justified.
Table 8 MRG2 is calibration; MRG1/MRG3 transfers have reported relative errors 21.9% and 19.2%, not broad independent validation.
Theoretical COD is composition-derived, not measured biodegradable COD; C/N is a source-reported calculation.
No GreenHub defaults, runtime mappings, scenario outputs, or workbook/API/UI override rules are changed.
transcription_note: Numeric records were transcribed from the open author manuscript tables/text. No fitted curves or missing uncertainty values were reconstructed.
